backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for a blog platform implementing post CRUD, draft management, user profiles, reactions (likes/dislikes), and role-based access control with owner/admin management.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features (autosave, save-as-draft, My Drafts page, unpublish dialog) to their source files, components, and test requirement IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document providing one-sentence summaries of each frontend source file, describing their roles in the blog application including routing, hooks, pages, and components.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS stylesheet defining OKLCH-based design tokens for light and dark modes, including colors for backgrounds, borders, charts, and sidebar elements.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React app with Swedish language attribute, HKLO as the page title, and a root div mounting the main.tsx module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: TanStack Router setup defining all application routes (home, post detail, create, edit, admin, login, drafts), wrapping protected routes in ProtectedRoute and Layout components.
frontend/src/components/admin/AllPostsSe: Admin section that lists all posts in a table with options to change post status via a dropdown, delete posts with a confirmation dialog, and open an edit modal.
frontend/src/components/admin/ManageAdmi: React component for managing admin users, allowing the owner to add new admins by principal ID and remove existing ones, with confirmation dialogs and toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/admin/ManageAuth: React component that lists all authors in a table and allows admins to remove an author along with all their posts, using a confirmation dialog and toast feedback.
frontend/src/components/admin/PostEditMo: Modal dialog for admins to edit an existing post's title, content, author, status, and images, supporting adding new images and removing existing ones before submitting updates.
frontend/src/components/ImageGallery.tsx: React component that converts Uint8Array image data to blob URLs with proper cleanup on unmount, displaying images in a responsive grid with loading states and error placeholders.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main application layout component with a sticky header containing navigation links (Home, Create Post, Drafts, Admin) that adapt based on authentication state and admin role, plus a footer.
frontend/src/components/PostCard.tsx: Card component for displaying a blog post preview with thumbnail image, title, author, date, content excerpt, share button, and reaction buttons.
frontend/src/components/ProtectedRoute.t: Route guard component that redirects unauthenticated users to the login page and shows a loading spinner while the Internet Identity session initializes.
Like/dislike button component with animated canvas-based particle confetti effects on interaction, fetching and updating reaction counts via query hooks.
frontend/src/components/ShareModal.tsx: Modal dialog for sharing a post via Email, WhatsApp, X (Twitter), Facebook, or by copying the URL to the clipboard.
Alert dialog that prompts the user to either permanently delete or save as draft when unpublishing a published post.
frontend/src/config/constants.ts: Exports a single constant containing the hardcoded admin principal ID string.
frontend/src/data/titleSuggestions.ts: Defines a Category type and a record of Swedish blog title suggestions grouped by category, plus an exported array of category names.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, reinitializing and invalidating dependent queries whenever the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useImageUpload.ts: Custom hook that handles client-side image selection, validation, compression/resizing via Canvas API, and conversion to Uint8Array blobs for upload, with error and processing state management.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient creation with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend interactions including CRUD operations for posts, reactions, drafts, admin/author management, and user identity checks.
frontend/src/hooks/useShare.ts: Custom hook that wraps the native Web Share API, returning a share function and an isSupported flag to indicate when a fallback modal is needed.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that sets up Tailwind CSS and defines CSS custom properties for a warm editorial color palette in both light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin panel page that checks caller admin status and renders tabbed sections for managing posts, admins, and authors, with loading and access-denied states.
frontend/src/pages/CreatePostPage.tsx: Page for creating new blog posts with fields for title, content, author, category, images, and publish toggle, including autosave-to-draft functionality every 30 seconds.
frontend/src/pages/EditPostPage.tsx: Page for editing existing posts that pre-populates form fields from fetched post data, enforces ownership checks, handles image management, and supports an unpublish dialog flow.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Displays a sorted list of all published blog posts using the PostCard component, with loading and error states handled.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Login page that authenticates users via Internet Identity, redirecting already-authenticated users to the home page.
frontend/src/pages/MyDraftsPage.tsx: Page for managing the current user's draft posts, supporting edit, publish, and delete actions with confirmation dialogs.
frontend/src/pages/PostDetailPage.tsx: Full post detail view with owner-only edit/delete controls, image gallery, reaction buttons, and a share modal; unauthenticated users see a login prompt.
frontend/src/utils/contentTruncator.ts: Utility that truncates post content to a maximum word count while preserving sentence boundaries when possible.
frontend/src/utils/dateFormatter.ts: Converts a nanosecond-precision IC Time value to a Swedish locale date string.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage fallback.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with dark mode, custom OKLCH-based design tokens, extended typography/serif fonts, border radii, and animation keyframes.
project_state.json: Tracks project state version 3 for a content platform, describing existing and planned features around draft/autosave functionality including autosave every 30 seconds, a 'My Drafts' section, save-as-draft button, and an unpublish confirmation dialog.
